rounds: Two weeks of showing up in the same gear, keeping the head down, going through the motions — that's the Joy Police running a pretty clean operation. The Apollo ring moment is the specific one though: a colleague opened a door and you closed it. Half naked man on your finger, and you folded.
pattern: They're letting you wear the thing but not be the thing.
focus: One stranger gets the Apollo ring story — however short, however messy.
